artifacts.summary: Four-phase quarantine of nine dead scripts, lint-contract-compliance.sh repair and wire-in as verify-deploy.sh gate 11, rule-loading/operator-tool documentation notes, and a wipe-and-regenerate final verification sweep.

completion_data.completion_summary: Quarantined nine dead scripts (eight core + one literature) into deprecated/ directories with per-file README rationale and manifest de-declaration; repaired lint-contract-compliance.sh's root resolution and wired it in as verify-deploy.sh gate 11; documented the four legitimate operator tools and the native rule-loading mechanism to prevent future mis-triage; and proved the quarantine holds via a destructive deploy-headless.sh --wipe rebuild plus a full verify-deploy.sh run (21/22 checks pass; the one failure is a pre-existing, unrelated test-index-entries-schema.sh defect).

memory_candidates.content: check-extension-docs.sh's Rule E (check_referenced_scripts_declared) scans commands/*.md, skills/*/SKILL.md, agents/*.md, README.md, and EXTENSION.md for bare *.sh/*.sql filename tokens and fails if the name isn't in provides.scripts (or provides.hooks). When quarantining a script (move to deprecated/ + drop manifest entry), also grep those five doc-file globs for the basename -- a mere naming-convention-precedent mention in prose (not an invocation) still trips this rule and must be reworded to drop the literal extension.

Two independent rule-loading paths exist for .claude/rules/*.md: (1) harness-native auto-load via each file's own YAML paths: frontmatter glob (independent of any import list), and (2) CLAUDE.md's curated @-import list. A rule absent from the @-import list is NOT thereby dead -- check its own paths: frontmatter before concluding it's unwired. This was the root cause of a prior false 'dead rule' finding.

When repairing a lint script's root-resolution to validate the source store (agent-system/extensions/**) instead of a deployed .claude/ tree, mirror the git-rev-parse-with-fallback pattern already used by lint-agent-contracts.sh (REPO_ROOT env override -> git -C SCRIPT_DIR rev-parse --show-toplevel -> relative fallback) rather than the scripts/-depth-specific common_repo_root(SCRIPT_DIR, N) helper, which assumes a fixed directory depth and silently resolves to the wrong root when a script lives two levels deeper (e.g. scripts/lint/). Also check for and fix any other script's comments that documented the old dependency on common_repo_root, since removing it can leave stale documentation elsewhere.
